title: "Structure"
knitr:
  opts_chunk:
    collapse: true

---

Each DRAGEN tool has a single `schema.yaml` under `inst/config/tools/<tool>/`.
See <https://tidywf.github.io/nemo/articles/structure.html> for a walkthrough of
the `Tool`/`Workflow`/`Config` class structure and schema contents.

tidydragen adds one intermediate base, `DragenTool` (inheriting `nemo::Tool`),
which all domain tools extend. It carries the DRAGEN-shared parsing logic, most
notably the `dragen-metrics` filetype that handles the headerless
`section,rg,variable,count[,pct]` shape common to DRAGEN `*_metrics.csv` files.
See the [UML](uml.html) article for the class diagram.
